description: Land Acquistion - Elliyaddha, Medadumbara D/S Division, Kandy District
categorisation: This gazette notice is a declaration under the Land Acquisition Act for the acquisition of a specific parcel of land (Aliyawatta) for a public purpose. The content is primarily focused on land matters, providing a detailed description of the property, its location, boundaries, and extent. While a government minister is named, the core subject is the land acquisition itself, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4) rather than a government personnel or hybrid classification.
